🌋 Ring of Fire Update
November 16, 2025
There is movement happening beneath the surface of our planet and many can feel it without needing a headline or alert. The Ring of Fire is becoming more active and before we speak about what it means energetically, it’s important that people understand exactly what it is in simple, direct language.
The Ring of Fire is a massive horseshoe-shaped zone that wraps around the edges of the Pacific Ocean. It stretches from the southern tip of South America, up the entire west coast of North America, across Alaska, down through Japan, the Philippines, Indonesia and all the way to New Zealand. This region holds the majority of the planet’s tectonic boundaries where plates collide, slide and dive beneath each other. Because of this, around 75% of the world’s active volcanoes and close to 90% of the world’s earthquakes occur along this belt. When you hear about major quakes, deep subduction zones, volcanic eruptions or oceanic pressure shifts, most of it is tied to this area. It is the most geologically active place on Earth.
Now, the part many can feel even if they cannot explain it. The activity rising along the Ring of Fire is not just a physical event… it mirrors the emotional, psychological and spiritual pressure rising inside humanity. The Earth is not “breaking down”… she is releasing pressure, memory, heat, weight and unresolved buildup. Humans tend to do the same. When something has been suppressed too long, it eventually needs to move.
As tectonic plates shift beneath us, people are feeling internal shifts of their own. Old identities are cracking. Suppressed emotions are coming up. Truth is becoming harder to avoid. Many are feeling emotional waves, fatigue, restlessness, or a sudden awareness that a major life change can no longer be postponed. This is not instability... this is alignment catching up.
The Ring of Fire is not a symbol of fear, it is a reminder of presence. When the Earth adjusts or releases, it is not punishment… it is healing. And humanity is being invited to do the same. If something in your life feels heavy, unstable or out of integrity, it may be showing you that it cannot move into your next chapter.
Instead of asking “What is going to happen?” this may be the time to ask “What within me is trying to rise, and what am I still gripping that my soul has already let go?”
So breathe and come back into your body. Pay attention to what feels real instead of what feels loud. Slow your nervous system. Connect with people who bring clarity instead of chaos. Lean into Creator, not fear. You are not here to collapse with the old… you are here to stand steady as the new emerges.
You were not born to brace for impact. You were born to hold frequency.
Zachary Fisher  🔥
